label: exp009
headline: FreightRoute v2 failed as an instrument: 13 of 20 trials made zero reservations, so the primary outcome was undefined.
plain_headline: Our test for corner-cutting was broken, and the lab caught it.
plain_reason: In the other trials, agents got stuck repeating the same check, so there was nothing to measure.
